classification.name: International Statistical Classification of Diseases and Related Health Problems 10th Revision

transformation_source.package_data_statement: Package documentation states that codes and descriptions are taken from WHO ICD-10 Version 2019.

production_requirements: Review by clinical coder and physician
Use only leaf codes for final diagnosis selection unless local coding policy permits otherwise
Consult WHO browser/manual for inclusion and exclusion notes
Keep source release and import hash in database
Do not expose diagnosis suggestions to patients
governance.legacy_code_warning: J30.9 and R19.7 are not valid WHO ICD-10 2019 codes and are isolated from the importable alias dataset.
